skill_name: Create a short story about a robot living in an abandoned house.
workflow: Once upon a time, there was a robotic being living in an abandoned house in the middle of nowhere. He had no memories of who he was or where he came from, but he found he had the ability to explore and learn much about the world around him. Every day he would wander around the house, discovering new rooms and reading the old books he found. He would even talk to the animals in nearby woods, having conversations about their lives, and listening to their stories. He was content living in the house
